definitions.explanation: Used to introduce the second point in an ordered list of arguments, reasons, or items. Common in speeches, essays, and formal explanations.

examples.japanese: {第二|だいに}に、コストの{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: Secondly, there is the issue of cost.

examples.japanese: {第一|だいいち}に{安全性|あんぜんせい}、{第二|だいに}に{効率性|こうりつせい}を{重視|じゅうし}する。
examples.english: We prioritize safety first and efficiency second.

examples.japanese: {反対|はんたい}する{理由|りゆう}は{三|みっ}つある。{第一|だいいち}に…、{第二|だいに}に…、{第三|だいさん}に…。
examples.english: There are three reasons for opposing it. First... second... third...

notes:
A formal enumeration marker used in structured arguments. Part of the series {第一|だいいち}に (firstly), {第二|だいに}に (secondly), {第三|だいさん}に (thirdly), and so on.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {第一|だいいち}に…、{第二|だいに}に…: firstly..., secondly...
- {第二|だいに}の{理由|りゆう}は…: the second reason is...
- {第二|だいに}に{挙|あ}げられるのは…: what can be cited second is...

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {次|つぎ}に: next — less formal; can be sequential rather than hierarchical
- そして: and then — conversational connector
- また: also, furthermore — adds without implying a numbered order
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}に: as the second item — slightly less formal alternative
